intro: Customer service representatives build service orientation, time management and problem solving, skills insurance, sales and billing teams hire for. Of the 25 careers below, Insurance Claims and Policy Processing Clerks match best at 91%, and 20 of the 25 pay more than the $44,770 median.
why_it_works: Customer service means calming upset callers, solving problems against a timer and explaining policies clearly. O*NET rates service orientation at 4 out of 5 for this job, so claims, sales and collections roles rank high. Sales representatives of services use your phone and persuasion skills with higher pay. Billing and claims work uses the same systems and accuracy. The skills to add include quality control, troubleshooting and managing resources.
tips: Use your call metrics, such as resolution rate or satisfaction scores, as proof of results on your resume.
Look at sales roles inside your own company, since sales representatives of services are a 90% match with much higher pay.
Volunteer for quality review or new hire training to build the skills supervisor roles look for.

faq.q: What jobs can customer service representatives do?
faq.a: The closest matches are Insurance Claims and Policy Processing Clerks (91%), Sales Representatives of Services, Except Advertising, Insurance, Financial Services, and Travel (90%) and Bill and Account Collectors (88%), based on O*NET 31.0. Tellers (85%) and Billing and Posting Clerks (82%) are also close.

faq.q: Which careers pay more than customer service?
faq.a: 20 of the 25 matches pay more than the $44,770 median for customer service representatives. Postmasters and Mail Superintendents earn $96,660 (+116%), Gambling Managers earn $93,220 (+108%) and Executive Secretaries and Executive Administrative Assistants earn $76,590 (+71%), according to BLS May 2025 data.

faq.q: Do I need a degree to leave customer service?
faq.a: Not for most options. 21 of the 25 matches usually need no more education than a customer service job, based on O*NET Job Zones. The other 4 usually need a certificate or associate degree, such as executive assistant roles.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to customer service?
faq.a: In the same field, the nearest roles are Credit Authorizers, Checkers, and Clerks (92% match), New Accounts Clerks (88%), Order Clerks (86%) and Receptionists and Information Clerks (86%). Banking roles like new accounts clerk use the same skills with more regular hours.
